Unable to find the requested oath.

chaos.name: Oath against Chaos
description: ## Oath against Chaos
‹SOURCE Inner Sea Combat/15›

Despite the seemingly inherent contradiction, the militant ‹rule/Hellknights› of Cheliax count a number of paladins among their ranks, especially the ‹hkorder/Order of the Godclaw›. Typically these paladins reconcile their allegiance to the Hellknights by dedication to the rule of law above all other things.
::ab[Detect Chaos (Su)]{icon=power ability="This ability works like the standard paladin ability to *detect evil,* except as ‹spell/detect chaos› instead of *detect evil.*" replace="Detect evil"}

::ab[Smite Chaos (Su)]{icon=power ability="This ability works like the standard paladin ability to *smite evil,* except the paladin gains bonuses against targets with chaotic alignments instead of evil. The paladin deals additional damage against outsiders with the chaotic subtype, chaotic-aligned dragons, and aberrations, instead of against evil outsiders, evil dragons, and undead." replace="Smite evil"}

::ab[Order of Good (Su)]{icon=power l4="She gains the ability to spend one use of her *lay on hands* ability when using her *smite chaos* ability to instead *smite evil,* as the paladin ability of the same name." replace="Channel positive energy"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Spread the order of law wherever you go, so long as the law is just; do not serve as a tool of tyranny. Fight vigilantly the servants of chaos."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1=Command s2="Calm emotions" s3=Suggestion s4="Order's wrath"}

corruption.name: Oath against Corruption
description: ## Oath against Corruption
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/60›

More insidious than meddling devils and more destructive than rampaging hordes are the strange alien entities that bubble up from the deep earth and the strange places beyond the sky. When a paladin takes this oath, she becomes a hunter of aberrations, protecting the common people from these bizarre threats. Often the paladin works in secret, not wanting to spread panic about her mission. Within cities they sometimes have underground bases that give access through the sewers and passages to strange vaults where the aberrant creatures live.

::ab[Aura of Purity (Su)]{l=3 icon=aura-def-protect passive="You gain a +4 sacred bonus on saves against spells and effects from creatures of the aberration type. Allies within 10 feet gain a +1 sacred bonus on these saves." special="This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead." replace="Aura of courage"}

::ab[Cleansing Flame (Sp)]{l=11 icon=lower-protect ability="You may expend two uses of your *smite evil* ability to ignite your weapon with a cleansing blue flame for 1 minute. This flame sheds light as a ‹eq-misc/torch›. Aberrations within 20 feet of the flame take a -4 penalty on attack rolls against you and your allies, and your allies within 20 feet of the flame gain a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and effects from aberrations." replace="Aura of justice"}

::ab[Cast into the Void (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-magic flavor="A paladin becomes a conduit for the power of her god." passive="Her DR increases to 10/evil." ability="Whenever she uses *smite evil* and successfully strikes an aberration, the creature must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier) or be banished to oblivion. This ability does not kill the creature, but it is sent to a remote place, such as deep underground or far into space (if it is a creature native to space), and cannot return under its own power for at least 100 years." ability2="Whenever the paladin ‹ability/channel«s» positive energy› or uses *lay on hands* to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount." replace="Holy champion" order=pa2}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Hunt aberrations and do not allow them to roam freely or harm others. Destroy them if you can, or banish them if you cannot."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="True strike" s2="Acute senses" s3="Touch of idiocy" s4="Spell immunity"}

fiends.name: Oath against Fiends
description: ## Oath against Fiends
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/61›

A paladin who takes an oath against ‹family/demon«s›, ‹family/devil«s›, ‹family/daemon«s›, and other evil outsiders is constantly on the lookout for malicious fiendish insurgence into the world, and faces it with swift and unwavering defiance. Often she works closely with ‹class/inquisitor«s›, searching for signs of outsider manipulation and possession.

::ab[Anchoring Aura (Su)]{l=8 icon=aura-magic ability="A paladin's aura hampers extradimensional travel by evil outsiders. The aura extends 20 feet from the paladin. Evil outsiders attempting to use abilities such as ‹spell/dimension door›, ‹spell/plane shift›, or ‹spell/teleport› to leave or enter the aura must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier); failure means the ability does not function, as if the outsider were affected by ‹spell/dimensional anchor›.~~~The aura functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead." immediate="Alternatively, the paladin can expend one use of her *smite evil* ability to target an evil outsider within 30 feet with *dimensional anchor.* A targeted *dimensional anchor* persists even if the paladin is unconscious or dead." order=ai replace="Aura of resolve"}

::ab[Holy Vessel (Su)]{l=9 icon=def ability="A paladin whose *divine bond* is with a weapon can also use her *divine bond* to augment her armor or shield with enhancement bonuses, or add any of the following armor or shield properties: ‹magic-enh/bashing›, ‹magic-enh/fortification›, and ‹magic-enh/spell resistance›. Adding these properties consumes an amount of bonus equal to the property's cost (see the ‹rule/magic_>armor« special abilities and shield special abilities tables›)." special="She can divide her bonuses from the *divine bond* ability among her weapon, armor, and shield as she sees fit. This ability has no effect for a paladin whose *divine bond* is with a mount." replace="9th-level mercy"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Never suffer an evil outsider to live if it is in your power to destroy it. Banish fiends you cannot kill. Purge the evil from those possessed by fiends."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Resist energy" s2="Detect thoughts" s3="Invisibility purge" s4="Plane shift"}

grotesquery.name: Oath against Grotesquery
description: ## Oath against Grotesquery
‹SOURCE Inner Sea Combat/15›

For paladins of the Eternal Rose, beauty is synonymous with virtue, and it is the lens through which all goodness is filtered. For champions of ‹faith/Shelyn›, who are aware that aesthetics is subjective, beauty is the form inviolate.

::ab[Beauty Unyielding (Su)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A paladin gains spell resistance equal to 11 + her paladin level, but only against non-harmless transmutation effects. This spell resistance can be lowered as a @HLstandard_action.~~~Additionally, whenever the paladin would take Charisma damage or suffer Charisma drain, she reduces the amount of damage or drain by 1 (minimum 0)." replace="Divine health"}

::ab[Restore True Beauty (Su)]{l=14 icon=aid ability="A paladin can expend two uses of her *lay on hands* ability to attempt to dispel any non-harmless transmutation effect on a target, as ‹spell/break enchantment›." ability2="Additionally, the paladin can expend two uses of her *lay on hands* ability to remove all of the target's temporary ‹rule/Charisma damage› and restore all points drained from its Charisma score, as ‹spell/restoration›." order=a2 replace="Aura of faith"}
:::block{size=simple hl}

::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Respect the innate beauty in all things, and strive to preserve it from corruption and perversion. Never willfully cause damage to crafted objects or works of art, nor cause a creature or object to be deformed in any way."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1=Sanctuary s2="Make whole" s3="Banish seeming" s4="True form"}

savagery.name: Oath against Savagery
description: ## Oath against Savagery
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/61›

Some paladins are champions of order, pledging to battle the hordes of goblinoids, orcs, hostile barbarians, and similar savages that nip at the heels of civilization, as well as those who gnaw on society from within, such as thieves' and assassins' guilds. More so than other paladins, those who take this oath expect to fight many creatures at once, and develop special abilities to deal with these numbers.

::ab[Holy Reach (Su)]{l=2 icon=boost ability="An oathbound paladin can expend one use of her *smite evil* ability to extend her natural reach by 5 feet for 1 minute. This does not stack with the ‹feat/Lunge› feat." replace="Divine grace"}

::ab[Hordebreaker (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost-melee ability="When the paladin hits an evil humanoid with an attack of opportunity, she deals an additional 1d6 points of damage. When using *holy reach,* the paladin may make a number of additional attacks of opportunity per round equal to her Charisma bonus. This increase stacks with similar increases from other sources such as ‹feat/Combat Reflexes›." replace="Aura of justice"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Always heed the call of a community in danger from savages. Be the first in line to defend a settlement and the last to retreat."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1=Deathwatch s2="Protection from arrows" s3=Haste s4="Divine power"}

the_whispering_way.name: Oath against the Whispering Way
description: ## Oath against the Whispering Way
‹SOURCE Divine Anthology/20›

The ‹rule/Whispering Way› is an enemy to all life in the world, and as a result many paladins feel called to contain its evil. (This oath is identical to the ‹oath/oath against »undeath› except for the *aura against necromancy* below.)
:::block{size=minimal}
::row[Deities]{info="‹faith/Angradd›, ‹faith/Arqueros›, ‹faith/Iomedae›, ‹faith/Sarenrae›, ‹faith/Torag›, ‹faith/Vildeis›."}

::ab[Detect Undead (Su)]{icon=power ability="This ability works like the standard paladin ability to *detect evil,* except as ‹spell/detect undead› instead of *detect evil.*" replace="Detect evil" special="You can regain *detect evil* through the ‹feat/Sin Seer› feat."}

::ab[Ghost Touch Aura (Su)]{icon=def l3="The paladin's armor is treated as if it had the ‹magic-enh/ghost touch<_a› armor property. This does not affect the cost or effect of any other abilities of the armor." l9="This ability also applies to the paladin's shield." replace="3rd-level and 9th-level mercies"}

::ab[Aura against Necromancy (Su)]{l=8 icon=aura-def-protect passive="The paladin gains a +4 morale bonus on saves against necromancy spells and spell-like abilities. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +2 morale bonus on these saves." special="This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead." replace="Aura of resolve"}

::ab[Superior Channeler (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost ability="A paladin can channel positive energy to harm undead by expending a single usage of her *lay on hands* ability instead of two." replace="Aura of justice"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Destroy agents of the Whispering Way and stop the spread of their philosophy."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Sanctify corpse" s2=Darkvision s3="Searing light" s4="Halt undead"}

the_wyrm.name: Oath against the Wyrm
description: ## Oath against the Wyrm
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/62›

Few dragons see the smaller races of the world as their equals - to most, humanoids are either food or an annoyance. Some paladins swear to protect others against the predation of dragonkind. Some include dragon-blooded creatures (such as half-dragons or even sorcerers with the draconic bloodline) in their oath and team up with ‹class/inquisitor«s› to root out those whose ancestry carries the taint of dragon magic. Many paladins with this oath are thrill-seekers for the cause of good, channeling their divine power in ways that allow them to take on their powerful foes head on.

::ab[Breath Evasion (Su)]{l=4 icon=def ability="A paladin with this oath gains ‹ability/evasion›, but only against the breath weapons of creatures with the dragon type." replace="Channel positive energy"}

::ab[Divine Bond (Sp)]{icon=power ability="This works like the paladin's normal *divine bond* ability, except as follows.~~~If the paladin's bond is with a weapon, she cannot use that ability to add the *brilliant energy, disruption,* or *merciful* weapon properties, but she can add the ‹magic-enh/bane› weapon property (but only against dragons).~~~If the paladin's bond is with her steed, the steed gains the paladin's *aura*-based immunities and her *aura* does not affect allies." replace="Divine bond"}

::ab[Dragon-Slaying Strike (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-magic-aid flavor="An oathbound paladin becomes a conduit of holy power." passive="Her DR increases to 10/evil." order=pa2 ability="Whenever she uses *smite evil* and successfully strikes a dragon, the dragon is also subject to a single-target ‹spell/holy word›, using her paladin level +10 as the caster level. After the banishment effect and the damage from the attack are resolved, the *smite* immediately ends." ability2="In addition, whenever she channels positive energy or uses *lay on hands* to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount." replace="Holy champion"}
:::block{size=simple hl}

::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Slay evil dragons, as well as other dangerous dragons whether or not they are evil. Prevent the bloodlines of other creatures from being corrupted with draconic power. Protect the innocent against the predation of dragons."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Enlarge person" s2="Bear's endurance" s3=Fly s4=Stoneskin}

undeath.name: Oath against Undeath
description: ## Oath against Undeath
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/61›

A paladin with this oath vows to restore the natural state of death to any animate corpse she encounters, and destroy the undead energy in the process. While a few paladins who take this oath recognize that not all undead are evil, others are quite willing to purge neutral and good undead along with all the evil ones.

::ab[Detect Undead (Su)]{icon=power ability="This ability works like the standard paladin ability to *detect evil,* except as ‹spell/detect undead› instead of *detect evil.*" replace="Detect evil" special="You can regain *detect evil* through the ‹feat/Sin Seer› feat."}

::ab[Ghost Touch Aura (Su)]{icon=def l3="The paladin's armor is treated as if it had the ‹magic-enh/ghost touch<_a› armor property. This does not affect the cost or effect of any other abilities of the armor." l9="This ability also applies to the paladin's shield." replace="3rd-level and 9th-level mercies"}

::ab[Aura of Life (Su)]{l=8 icon=aura-def-protect passive="The paladin gains a +4 morale bonus on saves against attacks that grant ‹rule/negative levels› and saves to overcome negative levels. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +2 morale bonus on these saves.~~~This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead." replace="Aura of resolve"}

::ab[Superior Channeler (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost ability="A paladin can channel positive energy to harm undead by expending a single usage of her *lay on hands* ability instead of two." replace="Aura of justice"}
:::block{size=simple hl}

::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Destroy all undead. Put to rest the poor souls turned against their will. Prevent the taint of undeath from spreading to the newly dead, blessing or burning the corpses as necessary."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Sanctify corpse" s2=Darkvision s3="Searing light" s4="Halt undead"}

charity.name: Oath of Charity
description: ## Oath of Charity
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/62›

Charity is more than just giving money to a temple or a cause - it is about the necessity of sacrifice to help others. Those who take this oath dedicate their lives to protecting those who can't protect themselves and giving to those who are in need. They are generous to a fault, the most steadfast of friends, and give without anyone needing to ask. Paladins who take the oath of charity often turn over a fifth or more of their acquired wealth gained through adventuring to their temples or community.

::ab[Charitable Hands (Su)]{l=2 icon=down-boost ability="A paladin with this oath heals 50% less when she uses *lay on hands* on herself, but 50% more than the normal amount when she uses it to heal others. Using *lay on hands* to harm undead deals the normal amount of damage. This ability otherwise works like and replaces *lay on hands.*"}

::ab[Charitable Mercy (Su)]{l=5 icon=power flavor="A paladin with this oath is more flexible with her mercies than other paladins." ability="At the start of each day, a paladin with this oath can select her mercies anew from the list of available ‹ability/mercies›." replace="Divine bond"}
:::block{size=simple hl}

::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Always offer help to good creatures who need it. Always offer help to the poor and destitute. (In settlements, this help is often handled by donating to charitable religious organizations, rather than the paladin being required to dole out coppers to every beggar in the street.)"}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Magic stone" s2="Make whole" s3="Magic vestment" s4="Imbue with spell ability"}

chastity.name: Oath of Chastity
description: ## Oath of Chastity
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/62›

A chaste paladin proves her purity by way of her action and her abstinence from romantic activities. Many believe that this oath is only about sex, but it is really an oath about the romantic notion that a single person could be more important than all the evils facing the world - it is this perceived selfishness that the bearer of the Oath of Chastity strives to reject. In doing so, she gains purifying power.

::ab[Pure of Mind (Su)]{l=2 icon=def passive="The paladin gains a +4 sacred bonus on saves against charm effects and figments, and gains a bonus equal to her Charisma modifier on Will saving throws." replace="Divine grace"}

::ab[Pure of Body (Su)]{icon=def l8="The paladin has a 50% chance to turn any critical hit or sneak attack against her into a normal hit, as if she were wearing ‹magic-enh/fortification› armor." replace="Aura of resolve"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Never engage in a romantic relationship or a sexual act."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Remove fear" s2=Confess s3=Heroism s4="Freedom of movement"}

loyalty.name: Oath of Loyalty
description: ## Oath of Loyalty
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/63›

To most paladins, their word is everything. When they say something, it will be done. Those who take this oath put that ideal to the test every day. The oathbound paladin's word is a promise, a sacred bond, and also greater power in the cause of law and good. She is careful with her words, lest she agree to something she cannot fully support.

::ab[Loyal Oath (Su)]{l=1 icon=protect swift="An oathbound paladin can choose a willing creature within line of sight as the target of her *loyal oath.* When the paladin is adjacent to the target of her *loyal oath,* she grants the target a sacred bonus on saving throws and to Armor Class equal to the paladin's Charisma bonus. The *loyal oath* lasts 1 minute, or until the paladin dismisses it (a @HLfree_action) or discharges it (see below), whichever comes first." immediate="While a *loyal oath* is active and the target is struck by an enemy and the paladin is adjacent to that enemy, she may make a single melee attack against that enemy; making this attack ends the *loyal oath.*" order=uwi useInc=oracle~3~1 useF="1~1~3" replace="Smite evil"}

::ab[Loyal Guardian (Su)]{l=8 icon=protect immediate="Whenever the target of the paladin's *loyal oath* is hit with a melee or ranged attack, if the paladin is adjacent to the target, she can have the attack automatically hit her instead of the intended target. This ends the *loyal oath.*"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Keep all promises. Never make an oath or promise lightly. Never go back on an oath."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1=Wrath s2=Aid s3="Helping hand" s4=Sending}

the_mendevian_crusade.name: Oath of the Mendevian Crusade
description: ## Oath of the Mendevian Crusade
‹SOURCE Divine Anthology/20›

The Worldwound threatens all of Golarion with the uttermost depths of depravity, and so paladins across the world stand firm against it. This oath is identical to the ‹oath/oath against »fiends› except as noted here.
:::block{size=minimal}
::row[Deities]{info="‹faith/Angradd›, ‹faith/Arqueros›, ‹faith/Iomedae›, ‹faith/Kols›, ‹faith/Ragathiel›, ‹faith/Sarenrae›, ‹faith/Torag›, ‹faith/Vildeis›."}

::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost-down ability="The paladin adds evil outsider ‹magic-enh/bane› to the list of weapon special abilities that can be added to her weapon and removes *flaming* from the list." alter="Divine bond"}

::ab[Anchoring Aura (Su)]{l=8 icon=aura-magic ability="A paladin's aura hampers extradimensional travel by evil outsiders. The aura extends 20 feet from the paladin. Evil outsiders attempting to use abilities such as ‹spell/dimension door›, ‹spell/plane shift›, or ‹spell/teleport› to leave or enter the aura must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier); failure means the ability does not function, as if the outsider were affected by ‹spell/dimensional anchor›.~~~The aura functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead." immediate="Alternatively, the paladin can expend one use of her *smite evil* ability to target an evil outsider within 30 feet with *dimensional anchor.* A targeted *dimensional anchor* persists even if the paladin is unconscious or dead." order=ai replace="Aura of resolve"}

::ab[Holy Vessel (Su)]{l=9 icon=def ability="A paladin whose *divine bond* is with a weapon can also use her *divine bond* to augment her armor or shield with enhancement bonuses, or add any of the following armor or shield properties: ‹magic-enh/bashing›, ‹magic-enh/fortification›, and ‹magic-enh/spell resistance›. Adding these properties consumes an amount of bonus equal to the property's cost (see the ‹rule/magic_>armor« special abilities and shield special abilities tables›)." special="She can divide her bonuses from the *divine bond* ability among her weapon, armor, and shield as she sees fit. This ability has no effect for a paladin whose *divine bond* is with a mount." replace="9th-level mercy"}
::ab[Mercy (Su)]{head l=12 icon=power ability="The paladin can choose the following mercy."}

::ab[Possessed]{next icon=aid ability="If the subject is affected by ‹spell/dominate person›, possessed, or otherwise magically controlled by an evil outsider, this mercy grants the victim a new saving throw against the effect to end the effect at once."}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Never suffer an evil outsider to live if it is in your power to destroy it. Banish fiends you cannot kill. Purge the evil from those possessed by fiends."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Resist energy" s2="Detect thoughts" s3="Invisibility purge" s4="Plane shift"}

the_peoples_council.name: Oath of the People's Council
description: ## Oath of the People's Council
‹SOURCE Divine Anthology/20›

The ‹rule/Eagle Knights› and the people of Andoran hold their elected officials to extremely high standards of conduct. Paladins swearing the oath of the People's Council serve the common good by finding and thwarting those who abuse their authority. Many seek specifically to emulate Talmandor, the agathion patron of Andoran.
:::block{size=minimal}
::row[Deities]{info="‹faith/Abadar›, ‹faith/Erastil›, ‹faith/Iomedae›, ‹faith/Ragathiel›, ‹faith/Shelyn›, ‹faith/Vildeis›."}
::cskill{gain=ling~per~perf lose=ha~ride~spc}

::ab[Stirring Monologue (Su)]{l=1 icon=power ability="The paladin can deliver a *stirring monologue* on the ideals of justice and fairness, motivating allies and persuading others. This functions as ‹ability/bardic performance› as per a bard of her paladin level using Perform (oratory). All the effects are language-dependent even if they would not normally be.~~~The paladin gains the following performances at the indicated levels." imp1="‹performance/Inspire courage›" imp4="‹performance/Fascinate›" imp5="‹performance/Inspire competence›" imp7="‹performance/Suggestion›" imp10="‹performance/Dirge of doom›" imp13="‹performance/Inspire greatness›" imp16="‹performance/Frightening tune›" imp19="‹performance/Mass suggestion›" replace="Smite evil"}

::ab[Aura of Truth (Su)]{l=11 icon=aura-def-protect passive="The paladin automatically succeeds at saving throws to disbelieve illusions of the phantasm subschool and automatically gains a saving throw to disbelieve figment illusions when she observes them. Allies within 30 feet gain a +4 bonus on saving throws to disbelieve illusions of the phantasm subschool." replace="Aura of justice"}

::ab[Champion of Andoran (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-protect-boost-aid flavor="An oathbound paladin becomes a champion of the people of Andoran." passive="Her DR increases to 10/evil." order=pa2 ability="Whenever she uses her *stirring monologue,* up to four creatures (including the paladin herself) affected by the *monologue* gain SR 30 against spells with the evil descriptor or spell-like abilities cast by evil outsiders or undead. Weapons wielded by those affected by her *stirring monologue* are treated as good, silver, and cold iron for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." ability2="In addition, whenever the oathbound paladin channels positive energy or uses *lay on hands* to heal a creature, she heals it the maximum possible amount." alter="Holy champion"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Know the laws of Andoran and do not exempt authorities from the application of the law."}
::ab[Oath Spells]{icon=learn s1="Comprehend languages" s2="Locate object" s3=Tongues s4="True seeing"}

the_skyseeker.name: Oath of the Skyseeker
description: ## Oath of the Skyseeker
‹SOURCE Divine Anthology/21›

The dwarven people look to the legendary Sky Citadels as beacons of dwarven culture. Paladins with the oath of the skyseeker swear to defend those citadels their people retain and to help reclaim those the dwarves have lost, hoping to one day rebuild them on the greatest, most honorable ideals of the dwarven gods.
:::block{size=minimal}
::row[Deities]{info="‹faith/Angradd›, ‹faith/Folgrit›, ‹faith/Kols›, ‹faith/Torag›, ‹faith/Trudd›."}

::ab[Smite Evil Hordes (Su)]{icon=power-down ability="When the paladin or an ally defeats the target of the paladin's *smite evil* ability, the paladin can change the target of her *smite* to a different target within 30 feet of the previously defeated target without using an action. The new target must be of the same creature type and subtype as the previous target. If no applicable target is within 30 feet, then the *smite evil* effect ends." special="The paladin's *smite* does not deal more damage to evil outsiders, dragons, or undead than to other evil creatures." alter="Smite evil"}

::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost-down ability="The paladin adds ‹magic-enh/mighty cleaving› to the list of weapon special abilities that can be added to her weapon and removes *flaming* from the list." alter="Divine bond"}

::ab[Mercy for the Lost (Sp)]{l=11 icon=magic flavor="The paladin can use the Sky Citadels as a beacon leading her on the path to her deity." ability="If she is on the Material Plane, the paladin can use ‹spell/find the path› once per day at her paladin level, but only to find her way to a known Sky Citadel. If she is not on the Material Plane, she can instead use this ability to use ‹spell/plane shift› as per the spell to travel to a known Sky Citadel." special="If she is in a Sky Citadel, she can expend her daily use of this ability to use *plane shift* to travel to the realm of her deity." replace="Aura of justice"}

::ab[Stalwart (Ex)]{l=14 icon=def flavor="The paladin's quest has strengthened her body and mind." passive="If she succeeds at a Fortitude or Will saving throw against an effect that has a reduced effect on a successful save, she instead avoids the effect entirely." special="A ‹misc/helpless› paladin does not gain the benefit of the *stalwart* ability." replace="Aura of faith"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Reclaim a Sky Citadel in the name of honorable dwarven ideals. Defend Sky Citadels already held by dwarves."}

vengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance
description: ## Oath of Vengeance
‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/63›

While all paladins uphold the principals of law and good, sometimes these ideas must have a ruthless and dangerous side. It often falls upon a paladin to bring justice in the form of vengeance upon heinous transgressors against law and good. These oathbound paladins are always on the hunt for those who have perpetrated evil, and are the instrument of Heaven's most definitive and implacable judgment.

::ab[Channel Wrath (Su)]{icon=power l4="She can spend two uses of her *lay on hands* ability to gain an extra use of *smite evil* that day." special="This ability has no effect for a paladin who does not have the *smite evil* ability." replace="Channel positive energy"}

::ab[Powerful Justice (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost ability="An oathbound paladin may spends one use of her *smite evil* ability to grant her allies within 10 feet the ability to *smite evil,* except they only gain the paladin's bonus to damage, not her *smite's* attack bonus or ability to bypass DR." replace="Aura of justice"}
:::block{size=simple hl}
::row[Code of Conduct]{info="Never let lesser eveils distract you from your pursuit of just vengeance."}
